title: A Gaussian carried once round by DG
shows: A Gaussian (width 0.08) carried once round a periodic unit domain by order-4 nodal discontinuous Galerkin on 64 elements comes back to where it began: it matches the exact translated profile to 2e-6 of its height of 1. Its error falls as h^(p+1): 2^4.9 per halving from 32 to 64 elements. Mass is kept to rounding.
source: J. S. Hesthaven and T. Warburton, Nodal Discontinuous Galerkin Methods (2008), §4.8 (the h^(p+1) error of the upwind scheme for linear advection).

checks.what: largest difference from the exact profile after one period
